name: meetlocal
description: Privacy-first browser video meetings with optional local AI

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @meetlocal/signaling && npm run build -w @meetlocal/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @meetlocal/signaling && npm run typecheck -w @meetlocal/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @meetlocal/signaling && npm run test -w @meetlocal/web
scripts.dev:signaling: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @meetlocal/signaling
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n signaling,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @meetlocal/signaling" "npm run dev -w @meetlocal/web"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
